title: Quick connect
description: Try a server without saving anything. Credentials stay in memory until you disconnect.
memoryNote: Nothing is written to the vault or the database.

trust.title: Trust this server?
trust.description: {{host}} has not been seen before. Check that this fingerprint matches the one your server administrator gave you.

save.title: Save as site
save.description: Keep {{host}} in your workspace. Credentials are stored encrypted in the vault.
save.name: Name

errors.remote_auth_failed: The server refused the username or password.
errors.destination_blocked: This address is not allowed by the server policy.
errors.host_unresolvable: The host name could not be resolved.
errors.invalid_protocol: This protocol is not available yet.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.too_many_quick_connections: Too many quick connections are open. Close one first.
errors.site_name_taken: A site with this name already exists.
errors.vault_locked: Unlock the vault to save sites.
